beats.desc: the man sets the tip of a blue-handled screwdriver into the top mounting screw of the black interior deadbolt plate while the other hand steadies the deadbolt
the man turns the screwdriver clockwise to drive the mounting screw and tighten the black deadbolt plate flush against the white door
